title: Wemba-Wemba - Wikipedia
text: The Wemba-Wemba are an Aboriginal Australian people in north-Western Victoria and south-western New South Wales, Australia, including in the Mallee and the Riverina regions.

title: Wemba Wemba dialect - Wikipedia
text: April 19, 2026 - Wemba Wemba is an extinct Aboriginal Australian language once spoken along the Murray River and its tributaries in North Western Victoria and South Central New South Wales.

title: Alice Skye - Wikipedia
text: March 24, 2026 - Alice Skye (born Alice Anderson) is an Australian singer and songwriter. She is a British and Wergaia/Wemba Wemba woman from Horsham.
